<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The Rex Matriarchs are four dinosaur bosses found on Anachronia</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Each Matriarch has its own attack style, weakness and mechanics</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ While the Matriarchs share a boss instance, only 3/4 share an arena</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Osseous' arena is accessed via teleportation device near the entrance, only after completion of the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Osseous_Rex_quest <nowiki>Osseous Rex quest</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="the-4-matriarchs"><ins><nowiki>The 4 Matriarchs</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="orikalka"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/982264010873376868.png?v=1" alt="orikalka" title="orikalka" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Orikalka</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Primarily attacks with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Vulnerable to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (+27% hit chance with fire spells)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="rathis"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/982264011049566238.png?v=1" alt="rathis" title="rathis" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Rathis</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Primarily attacks with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1" alt="poisonicon" title="poisonicon" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Vulnerable to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (+27% hit chance with stab)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="pthentraken"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/982264010839842916.png?v=1" alt="pthentraken" title="pthentraken" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Pthentraken</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
